info.title: Settlr API
info.description: Free/open-source Splitwise alternative. Integer cents ledger, Argon2id, JWT refresh rotation, cursor pagination.

Budget.description: spent counts EXPENSE ledger entries in [from, to) whose category is in category_ids (any when empty): wallet transactions and my shares of group expenses. With account_ids empty, transactions on accounts excluded from the balance are left out and every group share counts; with account_ids set, only entries booked to those accounts count (a group share only when I paid the expense from one of them). Income, transfers, planned items, ADJUSTMENT and LOAN transactions never count.

BackupDocument.description: Complete, versioned backup of the caller's data (version 2). Only live rows (not deleted) are included. Ids are stable (the stored ids). `data` is the version 1 flat group-expense list, kept for existing readers; personal_expenses are not exported separately because migration 0013 moved them into transactions (source PERSONAL_LEGACY).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client-generated key (1-128 visible ASCII characters, e.g. a UUID) that makes retries of this write safe. Scoped per user for 24 hours. The first request with a key runs normally and its response (2xx or 4xx) is stored; a retry with the same key, method, path and body replays that stored response verbatim with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and does not re-execute. While the first request is still running a retry gets 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` (retry later). Reusing a key for a different method, path or body gets 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. A malformed key gets 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID`. 5xx responses are not stored, so the request may be retried with the same key.

get.description: Case-insensitive substring search (min 1 character after trimming; empty q returns empty groups). users/groups/expenses behave as before. The wallet groups (transactions, accounts, loans, planned, budgets, categories, tags) are scoped to the caller (categories: own + system), matched with %, _ and \ treated literally (q is cut at 100 characters), ordered newest/first-by-sort-order and capped at 10 each. transactions match title, description or tag name, include planned items, and exclude ADJUSTMENT and LOAN sources (loans are listed in `loans`).

get.description: Wallet transactions plus my group-expense shares (my share is my expense; if I paid from an account the full amount leaves it) and settlements booked to my accounts (account effect only). Group entries are read-only. Order: sort_at desc, id desc (the cursor encodes both). Group expenses created on their expense_date (UTC) sort at their creation time, otherwise at 00:00 UTC of expense_date, so a group expense added later in the day sorts above earlier wallet transactions; date filters still select by date.

post.description: Sets occurred_at (default now) so the item counts in balances, optionally overriding amount/to_amount/account_id. For a plan's occurrence the next one is generated (month arithmetic clamps to the month end from the plan's start_at: Jan 31 → Feb 28 → Mar 31); a one-time plan becomes inactive. 409 NOT_PLANNED if already paid, 409 LOAN_MANAGED for loan bookings. When account_id names an account whose currency differs from the item's: a sent `amount` is taken as minor units of the account currency; otherwise the item's amount is converted with the user's rates (overrides first, then daily rates), and 422 RATES_UNAVAILABLE is returned when no rate exists. The booked currency is always the account's. For a TRANSFER without `to_amount`, a same-currency pair follows the amount, otherwise the original to_amount (destination currency) is kept.
Deletes this unpaid occurrence; for a plan the next occurrence is generated (one-time plan → inactive). Response has only `next`. 409 NOT_PLANNED if already paid.

Skips every unpaid planned item due before now; recurring plans move to their first occurrence due now or later, one-time plans become inactive. Optional filters (query, comma lists as on GET /transactions): `account` (matches account_id or to_account_id) and `category`.

get.description: All wallet transactions of the caller, newest first (planned items included with planned=true and date = due date; ADJUSTMENT and LOAN bookings included, see the source column). Group-share ledger entries are not included. Streamed. Header: id,date,planned,type,title,description,account,to_account,category,tags,amount_minor,amount,currency,to_amount_minor,to_amount,to_currency,source. Text cells that start with = + - @ (or a tab/CR) are prefixed with ' (CSV/formula injection protection); amounts are never prefixed. RFC 4180 quoting. Amounts: *_minor are stored minor units (hundredths of the major unit for every currency), the unprefixed columns the same value as a decimal string with 2 decimals.

Live accounts (archived included). Header: id,name,currency,color,icon,include_in_balance,is_default,archived,created_at. Text cells that start with = + - @ (or a tab/CR) are prefixed with ' (CSV/formula injection protection); amounts are never prefixed. RFC 4180 quoting. Amounts: *_minor are stored minor units (hundredths of the major unit for every currency), the unprefixed columns the same value as a decimal string with 2 decimals.

Budgets with category/account names joined by '; '. Header: id,name,amount_minor,amount,currency,categories,accounts. Text cells that start with = + - @ (or a tab/CR) are prefixed with ' (CSV/formula injection protection); amounts are never prefixed. RFC 4180 quoting. Amounts: *_minor are stored minor units (hundredths of the major unit for every currency), the unprefixed columns the same value as a decimal string with 2 decimals.

Loans with totals (amount + increases, paid = decreases, remaining). Header: id,name,type,amount_minor,amount,currency,total_minor,total,paid_minor,paid,remaining_minor,remaining,paid_off,account,date,note. Text cells that start with = + - @ (or a tab/CR) are prefixed with ' (CSV/formula injection protection); amounts are never prefixed. RFC 4180 quoting. Amounts: *_minor are stored minor units (hundredths of the major unit for every currency), the unprefixed columns the same value as a decimal string with 2 decimals.
